name: Free the Hollows
label: Quest
description: Free the Hollows: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... Just so sad.
I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
